text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mei Satake told me there was "somewhere she wanted to go,"
and when I followed along…… we ended up aboard a ship.

text_block_list.name: Chef-Looking People
text_block_list.text:
"About that restaurant you told me about the other day..."
"Have you given it some thought? It seems they're looking for a Japanese cuisine chef right now..."

text_block_list.name: Madames
text_block_list.text:
"I inherited some land, but I'm at a complete loss for what to do with it..."
"Ohoho, I know exactly what you mean."
choice_data_list: What kind of gathering is this……?!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Well, that's just how it goes!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Everyone here loves Umamusume racing.
Today is a mixer party for all of us.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
You're in the position of actually guiding Umamusume.
I thought everyone would be thrilled!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you enjoy yourself too, Trainer <username>!
It's not every day we get a chance like this!

text_block_list.name: Chef-Looking Person
text_block_list.text: Pardon me, were you just with Trainer...?!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Ah, he's a Trainer at Tracen Academy.
Still a rookie, but his passion and drive are second to none!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Ah, she's a Trainer at Tracen Academy.
Still a rookie, but her passion and drive are second to none!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: I was thinking of treating you to a meal to show my appreciation sometime soon... Your restaurant serves Japanese cuisine, correct?

text_block_list.name: Chef-Looking Person
text_block_list.text:
Haha, spot on!
Be sure to stop by my place next time—
I'll throw in something on the house!

text_block_list.name: Madame
text_block_list.text: My, my, to put such careful thought into your coaching...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Finding the optimal solution within limited time and facilities!
Trainer <username>,
you are truly remarkable!
choice_data_list: Oh, no, it's just constant trial and error every day.

text_block_list.name: Madame
text_block_list.text:
Because you're all putting in your utmost effort,
our hearts burn with passion watching your races...
Fufu, it makes me want to cheer for you even more!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Mei Satake stepping right into the crowd,
I naturally ended up talking with plenty of people too.
Enjoying the socializing――

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Whew, that should about do it, I suppose……

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Mm, yeah.
...I guess I can tell you.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: About this party... I wanted to establish some connections across various circles, you see.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Indeed. For the sake of the Umamusume who dare to challenge that great wall abroad.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
As you know, the burden placed on them during an overseas tour is substantial.
Care for both the physical and mental side is essential—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: That is precisely why I want to support them with everything I have. Nutrition, environment—I'll use every connection at my disposal so they can challenge it in peak condition.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...And so, in this modest way, I continue seeking new connections.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>,
you were an immense help today.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Because you're so straightforward.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Anyone who looks can see that passion immediately.
That's why I think it resonates with everyone's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...It's because of you that we got so many people to lend a hand today.
Thank you.
choice_data_list: ...Next time, I want to properly help out too!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Haha, even if it was unconscious,
you were already a tremendous help to me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, the music playing onboard
shifted. People in the plaza began stepping in rhythm
to the lively, upbeat tune.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Oh, dance time?
...I know!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Straight to the point: I need your help!
From here on out, dancing is our means of diplomacy!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
That's our Trainer for ya!
I bet you've got killer dance moves too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!
Those words carry the utmost credibility!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, I consider myself quite passionate, but...
even I am humbled by your sheer zeal!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, not much of a dancer? 
In that case, let me lend you a hand.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: I may not look it, but taking the lead is kinda my specialty, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Oho, looking quite sharp now!
C'est super! Stand tall and proud, Trainer!
